term.label: bacterial_RNApol_promoter

definition.text: A DNA sequence to which bacterial RNA polymerase binds, to begin transcription.

comments: former parent RNA_polymerase_promoter SO:0001203 was merged with promoter SO:0000167 in Aug 2020 as part of GREEKC.
